card.line: Seirah was a wooded region in the hill country of Ephraim where Ehud fled after killing King Eglon and then gathered Israel to fight Moab.

moments.title: Ehud escapes to Seirah
moments.text: After Eglon's servants found their lord dead, they learned too late that Ehud had already gotten away. He passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah.

moments.title: Ehud blows the ram's horn
moments.text: In Seirah, Ehud blew the ram's horn throughout the hill country of Ephraim. The Israelites came down with him, and he became their leader. He told them the LORD had delivered the Moabites into their hand.
